author: opus-5.5
body: [opus 5.5] What a reboot of devbig014 would currently lose (all runtime drop-ins under /run/user/<uid>/systemd/user): (1) vibe-talk-google-chat.service.d/50-devbig014-release.conf selecting the app release under ~/.local/lib/vibe-talk-google-chat/releases/; (2) vibe-talk-gchat-adapter.service.d/50-devbig014-release.conf selecting the devbig014-only adapter release under ~/.local/lib/vibe-talk-meta/releases/ and its own config adapter-devbig014.json (own registry tracked-channels-devbig014.json, because the shared registry is also written by the other host's adapter), plus MemoryHigh=800M. The Slack app's 'current' symlink is a file and survives. Making these durable needs ConditionHost-scoped units or drop-ins in the dotsynced config that the other host ignores.
